networkAccess.reasoning: DS Bridge reads design token files from the team's GitHub repository through the GitHub REST API (api.github.com) and opens a pull request or an issue with the designer's variable edits. It also calls the Bridge site, bridgedesignsystem.com, with the designer's GitHub sign-in: "Sign in with Bridge" gets a one-time code (POST /api/plugin-link) and polls until the designer picks their team; after a push of token values it asks Bridge to merge that pull request once its checks pass (POST /api/ship). No analytics and no AI service: the plugin never calls Anthropic and holds no API key.
